title: Marketplace readiness quickscan + copy ledger
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight quickscan and copy ledger for cloud marketplace listing prep across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The goal is to create a single, scannable document that: 1) captures the minimal technical & legal gating items for publishing, 2) produces buyer-facing copy variants (hero tile + short/long descriptions) for experimentation, and 3) surfaces outstanding assets and owners so launch PMs can close the loop quickly.

Audience:
- GTM PMs and launch owners
- Partner integrations engineers
- Legal / Finance reviewers
- Creative (design & copy) for final assets

Top-level launch thesis (one-liner):
Redwood Inference — production-ready LLM inference for developers: predictable latency, cost controls, and unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.

Buyer-facing copy (tile + variants) — use these as A/B starting points:
1) Tile title (concise): Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference
   Short description (1 line / tile): Turn LLM prototypes into production with low-latency, cost-aware inference across hosted, dedicated and private deployments.

2) Short (1 sentence) variant:
   Deploy models at scale with predictable latency and lower per-token cost — hosted API, dedicated GPU pools, or private VPC options.

3) Long (2–3 sentence) variant:
   Redwood Inference helps engineering teams ship LLM-powered features by providing a unified runtime that optimizes for latency, throughput, and cost. Choose hosted for fastest onboarding, Dedicated for predictable throughput, or Private for compliance-sensitive workloads — all with rollout controls, tracing, and cost observability.

4) Developer-first callout (for tile/prominent bullet):
   Fast SDKs, streaming responses, and clear performance profiles so your app’s latency and unit economics are predictable in production.

Pricing & trial language (copy anchors):
- Try free credits on sign-up; pay-as-you-go token pricing thereafter.
- Dedicated subscription: monthly reserved capacity with SLA-backed targets.
- Private deployments: contact sales for pricing and compliance add-ons.
- Trial badge suggestion: "Free trial available — includes $500 platform credits" (confirm with finance).

Technical & publishing quick checklist (minimal gating items — mark owner/ticket and ETA):
- Marketplace account & publisher registration: owner: Marco Ruiz — Ticket: JIRA-4120 — ETA: 2025-11-10
- Billing SKU / metering contract drafted: owner: Leah Chen (finance) — Ticket: JIRA-4189 — ETA: 2025-11-14
- Entitlement/seat model definition for marketplace: owner: Benji O'Connell — Ticket: JIRA-4220 — ETA: 2025-11-12
- Legal reviewed terms & marketplace addendum: owner: Sofia Marin — Ticket: LEG-203 — ETA: 2025-11-18
- SSO & provisioning integration (if required): owner: eng-plat — Ticket: ENG-5932 — ETA: 2025-11-22
- Product images & tile assets (logos + 2 screenshots): owner: Creative — PR: #86 — ETA: 2025-11-06
- Architecture diagram (1-slide): owner: infra — Ticket: DOC-112 — ETA: 2025-11-09
- Test plan for functional flows (purchase + provisioning + SSO): owner: QA — Ticket: QA-708 — ETA: 2025-11-16
- Support and onboarding docs (marketplace-specific): owner: Customer Success — Ticket: CS-621 — ETA: 2025-11-20

Security & compliance gate (short form):
- Data residency statement (yes/no + where): _______
- Encryption at rest in transit: confirmed (KMS/HSM integration required for private): owner: security — Ticket: SEC-334
- Pen test / attestation for marketplace: owner: security — ETA aligned with Legal sign-off

Packaging variants to include on listing (recommended):
- Hosted API (SaaS): quickstart + API key onboarding + free trial credits
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): SKU mapping for minimum throughput tiers, burst options, SLA summary
- Private (VPC/on-prem): contact-sales CTA, compliance bundle checklist (SOC2, ISO, FedRAMP notes if relevant)

Minimal asset inventory (what marketing & creative needs now):
- 1 hero PNG (1600x1000) + white/transparent logo (SVG)
- 2 product screenshots: Console route view (trace + latency graph), Rollout/Canary config UI
- 1 architecture slide (PNG) + PDF spec for on-prem install summary
- 3 customer quote snippets (short) — source: account execs

Acceptance criteria (what qualifies us to publish):
- Billing and SKU live in marketplace test sandbox and purchasing flow completes end-to-end
- Trial credit provisioning works and appears in customer console
- Entitlement mapping provisions access to the correct deployment (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private)
- At least one supported region has validated capacity & latency SLOs
- Legal, security, and finance have signed off (email or ticket closure)

Launch timeline (high-level):
- Week 0–1: finalize listing copy + creative assets; register publisher (owners: PM + creative)
- Week 2: complete billing & entitlement setup in marketplace sandbox; run purchase test (owners: finance, eng)
- Week 3: finalize legal terms and security attestation; internal dry-run with CS/Support
- Week 4: public listing + soft-launch to partner channel; monitor telemetry and purchase flows

Quick experiments & measurement (post-launch):
- A/B tile copy: short vs. long description; measure click-to-onboard conversion and trial starts
- Trial-to-paid funnel by packaging (hosted vs dedicated): measure time to first API call and first paid commit
- Latency callouts: experiment with "<50ms median for small requests" vs. conservative wording; track support tickets for performance complaints

Open questions / risks:
- Marketplace pricing granularity: do we surface per-token pricing or only monthly committed tiers? (need finance decision)
- Support SLAs mapped to marketplace expectations for trial customers vs. paid committed customers
- How to represent model catalog breadth on the tile without exceeding copy length (suggest link to model catalog page)

Next steps (short to-do):
- PM: lock hero tile copy and 1-line description by 2025-11-05 (owner: Aisha Patel)
- Creative: produce hero image + 2 screenshots by 2025-11-06 (owner: Creative)
- Finance: finalize SKU and trial credit wording by 2025-11-08
- Eng: validate provisioning + SSO test path by 2025-11-14

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally minimal and meant to move fast. If you need a fully templated checklist (spreadsheet with columns for ticket, owner, status, evidence link), ping me and I’ll convert.
- Lean experimental approach: publish a conservative tile copy, measure conversion, expand with variant copy and localized descriptions once baseline metrics are stable.

History / context:
- Draws from prior marketplace runs (see channel lessons in Confluence) but focuses on low-friction assets & gating items to get us into the listing sandbox quickly.

Contact: Aisha Patel (aisha.patel@redwood.ai) — ping in slack #marketplace-launch for synchronous follow-ups.
